issue.author: Danny
issue.title: Charging session stalls at 80% on DC fast chargers
issue.label: Charging
issue.description:
When starting a session on **DC fast chargers** (tested on Ionity and Smatrics), the session stalls at ~80% and never resumes.

**Steps to reproduce**
1. Start a DC session from the app
2. Wait until SoC reaches 80%
3. Observe power drop to 0 kW while the session stays active

**Expected:** charging tapers and continues to the configured limit.

comments.author: Lena Hofer
comments.body: Reproduced on firmware 4.2.1. Logs show the charger sending a pause request we never acknowledge.

comments.author: Marco Steiner
comments.body: Looks related to the OCPP 1.6 SetChargingProfile handling we changed last sprint. I'll put a fix up for review.

comments.author: Danny
comments.body: Thanks both — let's target the 4.2.2 hotfix.
